intent: A field of light points rolling toward the viewer in long swells: a calm, expensive-looking hero background that responds to the pointer without ever competing with the copy.

stack.3d: three (plain Three.js, one Points mesh, custom ShaderMaterial with 2D simplex noise)

layout.component: fills its parent (absolute inset-0 behind a hero works best)
layout.field: a grid 18 units wide and 14 deep, dense along x and spaced along z so it reads as contour lines of swell: 380×80 points on desktop, 200×96 under 640px
layout.camera: PerspectiveCamera fov 42 (58 on portrait boxes) at (0, 1.2, 5.2) looking at (0, 0.75, −3), so the horizon sits just below the middle of the frame
layout.demo: centred hero: mono eyebrow with an accent dot, display headline with a white/45 second clause, body, two pill buttons; a black-to-transparent gradient over the top half keeps the copy clean; a faint warm radial wash sits behind the horizon

typography.hint: mono 10.5px uppercase tracking 0.18em white/40 in a black/60 pill

color.crest: #ff7a45, blended in as height rises from 0.04 to 0.42
color.trough: #5b1a2e, a deep warm shadow in the lowest troughs
color.blending: additive, depthWrite off, so dense crests bloom naturally
color.fade: fog between depth 5 and 16, a near-camera fade, a 45%→100% spotlight down the centre, and soft left/right edges

motion.waves: two sine swells, a broad simplex noise drifting toward the viewer and a fine chop; speed multiplier prop
motion.pointer: the pointer is ray-cast onto the y=0 plane and lifts a Gaussian mound (0.38) that follows it with 0.08 lerp; strength eases in and out over about a second
motion.ripple: pointerdown drops a ring that travels outward at 3.2 units/s and decays over about 3s
motion.reducedMotion: single static frame, no pointer response
motion.entrance: canvas fades in 900ms while amplitude rises from 0 over 1.6s ease-out
motion.buttons: white pill deepens its glow on hover; pills scale 0.97 on press

responsive.density: fewer points under 640px, and the field starts 1.5 units further from the camera so near rows don't spread
responsive.lens: wider fov on portrait boxes so the field still spans the frame
responsive.performance: DPR capped at 2; one draw call; pauses offscreen and in hidden tabs

accessibility: canvas is aria-hidden; the hero copy carries the meaning
hint copy switches for touch devices
copy sits over a gradient so contrast never depends on the animation

content.headline: Read the sea before it reaches the shore.
content.body: 2,400 buoys streaming swell height, period and direction every four seconds…

avoid: letting the field run behind body copy without a gradient
